# Surrey Contracting Limited — Full Business Description

Surrey Contracting Limited is a groundworks, bulk earthworks and demolition contractor headquartered at Unit 3, Tannery House, Tannery Lane, Send, Woking, Surrey, GU23 7EF. The company has been delivering residential, commercial and developer-led external works projects for over 15 years, self-delivering every discipline with its own teams, plant and operators — no chains of subcontractors. Strapline: Groundworks, Earthworks & Demolition across Surrey & the Home Counties.

## Services

Surrey Contracting delivers three core construction disciplines, plus site enabling works:

### 1. Groundworks (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks)
Foundations (strip, trench fill, raft and piled caps), foul and surface-water drainage, soakaways, attenuation, utility trenching and service ducting, concrete slabs and oversite, substructure and build to DPC, retaining walls and gabion structures, site preparation, reduce dig and muck-away. Delivered for residential extensions and self-builds through to commercial developments.

### 2. Bulk Earthworks & Excavation (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/earthworks)
Cut and fill operations to levels and tolerances, large-scale bulk excavation, site strip and topsoil management, stockpiling, site levelling, land clearance and remediation, capping, attenuation basins, ponds and bunds, and bulk muck-away using the company's own and partner fleet. Plant includes tracked excavators from 1.5 to 35 tonnes, dozers, dumpers and rollers, all with experienced in-house operators.

### 3. Demolition (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/demolition)
Commercial and residential structural demolition, internal soft strip-out, site clearance and enabling works, on-site concrete crushing and recycling, site hoarding and security, coordination of licensed asbestos removal by HSE-licensed specialists, and waste management and disposal.

Demolition sub-services:
- Soft Strip-Out & Internal Demolition (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/soft-strip-out): controlled removal of non-structural elements, including fixtures, fittings, internal finishes, non-load-bearing partitions, suspended ceilings and redundant M&E, ahead of refurbishment or demolition, for commercial, retail, hospitality and residential buildings. Waste is segregated and recycled where possible; asbestos is removed by licensed asbestos removal contractors, not by Surrey Contracting.
- Site Hoarding & Security (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/site-hoarding): solid timber hoarding, surface-mounted and dug-in hoarding, temporary security fencing, vehicle and pedestrian gates, and CCTV and alarm coordination through specialist security partners, for demolition sites.

### 4. Site Enabling Works (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/site-enabling-works)
The early works that make a site safe, accessible and ready to build: site clearance, demolition and soft strip, hoarding and temporary access, coordination of utility diversions and disconnections with specialist, accredited contractors, on-site crushing and waste management, and ground preparation through to groundworks. Delivered as a stand-alone package or as part of a full groundworks solution.

Other pages:
- Sectors (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/sectors): education, hotels and leisure, retail and high street, housebuilders and residential, local authority and public sector, and commercial and industrial clients.
- Health & Safety (https://surreycontracting.co.uk/health-safety): CDM planning, RAMS, competent supervision, plant and excavation safety, dust and noise controls, and regular inspections and reviews.

## Coverage Area

Based at Send, near Woking, Surrey, the company operates across Surrey, London and the South East — including Cobham, Leatherhead, Guildford, Esher, Woking, Reigate, Dorking, Epsom, Weybridge, Kingston upon Thames, Redhill, Surbiton, the wider M25 ring and the A3 corridor.

Full coverage list with distances from the yard: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/areas

Towns with a dedicated groundworks page:
- Guildford: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks-guildford (about six miles from the Send yard; backed by a published case study in the town)
- Woking: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks-woking (the yard at Send is inside Woking borough; backed by a published case study in the borough)
- Weybridge: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks-weybridge (about eight miles; no Weybridge case study published yet, the page shows the nearest work at Cobham and says so)
- Epsom: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/groundworks-epsom (about fifteen miles; no Epsom case study published yet, the page shows the nearest work at Cobham and says so)

Guides (reference content, no prices published):
- Planning groundworks: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/guides/groundworks-planning covers drawings, site investigation, drainage approvals and building control inspection stages.
- What drives demolition cost: https://surreycontracting.co.uk/guides/demolition-cost-uk breaks a demolition quotation into its cost lines and explains how to compare quotations. The company does not publish rates; work is quoted per project after a measured site visit.

## Accreditations & Compliance

- Constructionline Gold member
- CHAS accredited contractor
- SSIP (Safety Schemes in Procurement) certified
- SMAS Worksafe
- CITB registered; operatives hold CSCS and CPCS qualifications; NPORS and IPAF
- £10m public liability insurance
- RAMS, toolbox talks and site supervision on every project; audit-grade paperwork and O&M handover packs

## How the Company Works

1. Free measured site visit within 5 working days of enquiry — levels, access, services and constraints captured.
2. Fixed-price itemised quote: materials, plant, prelims and programme.
3. Mobilise and deliver: RAMS issued, plant booked, weekly progress reports.
4. Sign-off and handover: snag-walk, O&M pack, 12-month defects window.

The company responds to all enquiries within one working day.
